title: AI and Data Scientist

nodes.title: Statistical Foundations & Probability Distributions
nodes.subtitle: Normal, binomial, Poisson distributions, central limit theorem, z-scores, p-values
learning_objectives: Explain how the Central Limit Theorem enables statistical inference on non-normal populations
Calculate confidence intervals and z-scores for continuous business distributions
feynman_prompts: Why does the Central Limit Theorem apply regardless of the underlying population distribution shape?
key_misconceptions: Assuming small sample sizes (N < 30) behave like normal distributions without using t-distributions

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Advanced Feature Engineering
nodes.subtitle: Handling missing data, scaling (Standard, Robust), one-hot encoding, target encoding, interaction terms
learning_objectives: Transform raw, noisy datasets into engineered features that boost model predictive power
Prevent data leakage by fitting transformers strictly on training splits
feynman_prompts: What is data leakage and how does fitting scalers on full datasets invalidate test scores?
key_misconceptions: Applying fit_transform() on testing datasets instead of transform() alone

nodes.title: Supervised Learning: Linear Regression & Regularization
nodes.subtitle: OLS regression, Ridge (L2), Lasso (L1), ElasticNet, bias-variance trade-off, MSE/RMSE/R2
learning_objectives: Build regularized regression models and analyze feature selection using Lasso L1 penalties
Diagnose underfitting vs overfitting using training and validation learning curves
feynman_prompts: How does Lasso (L1) regularization force regression coefficients to exactly zero for feature selection?
key_misconceptions: Assuming high R-squared guarantees model accuracy without checking residual error plots

nodes.title: Classification Algorithms & Threshold Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Logistic regression, decision thresholds, ROC-AUC curves, precision-recall trade-offs, confusion matrix
learning_objectives: Select optimal classification decision thresholds to minimize costly false negatives
Evaluate imbalanced classification models using Precision-Recall AUC rather than ROC-AUC
feynman_prompts: Why is classification accuracy a misleading metric for highly imbalanced datasets (e.g. 99% negative)?
key_misconceptions: Defaulting to a 0.5 probability threshold when false negatives carry 10x higher business cost

nodes.title: Tree-Based Models: Decision Trees & Random Forests
nodes.subtitle: Gini impurity, information gain, bagging, ensemble learning, feature importance, out-of-bag error
learning_objectives: Train robust Random Forest ensembles that reduce single-tree variance
Interpret feature importance and out-of-bag (OOB) error estimates
feynman_prompts: How does bootstrap aggregation (bagging) reduce variance without increasing model bias?
key_misconceptions: Allowing decision trees to grow to infinite depth, memorizing training noise

nodes.title: Gradient Boosted Decision Trees: XGBoost & LightGBM
nodes.subtitle: Boosting mechanics, residual fitting, learning rate, tree depth, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost
learning_objectives: Train high-performance gradient boosted decision trees using XGBoost and LightGBM
Tune learning rates, subsample ratios, and early stopping rounds to maximize leaderboard metrics
feynman_prompts: Explain how gradient boosting trains trees sequentially on the residual errors of previous trees.
key_misconceptions: Setting learning rates too high in gradient boosting, causing optimization divergence

nodes.title: Unsupervised Learning: Clustering & Segmentation
nodes.subtitle: K-Means, inertia, silhouette scores, DBSCAN density clustering, hierarchical clustering
learning_objectives: Segment customer behavioral datasets using K-Means and determine K with silhouette analysis
Identify arbitrary density clusters and outliers using DBSCAN
feynman_prompts: Why does K-Means fail when applied to non-spherical or widely varying density clusters?
key_misconceptions: Picking the number of clusters (K) arbitrarily without elbow method or silhouette validation

nodes.title: Dimensionality Reduction: PCA & t-SNE
nodes.subtitle: Principal Component Analysis (PCA), eigenvalues, variance explained, t-SNE vs UMAP visualization
learning_objectives: Reduce multi-hundred-feature datasets into principal components capturing 95% variance
Visualize high-dimensional data manifolds in 2D using t-SNE and UMAP
feynman_prompts: Why is PCA a linear projection technique while t-SNE preserves non-linear local neighborhood topology?
key_misconceptions: Using t-SNE output coordinates as features for downstream predictive models

nodes.title: Deep Learning Foundations with PyTorch
nodes.subtitle: PyTorch tensors, computation graphs, autograd, forward pass, loss functions, Adam optimizer
learning_objectives: Build and train custom neural networks in PyTorch using nn.Module and autograd
Implement the standard training loop: zero_grad, forward, backward, step
feynman_prompts: Why must optimizer.zero_grad() be called before loss.backward() in PyTorch training loops?
key_misconceptions: Forgetting to call model.eval() during validation, leaving Dropout and BatchNorm active

nodes.title: Computer Vision: Convolutional Networks (CNNs)
nodes.subtitle: Convolutions, kernels, padding, pooling, ResNet architecture, transfer learning with Torchvision
learning_objectives: Fine-tune pre-trained vision backbones (ResNet, EfficientNet) for domain image classification
Explain how convolutional kernels detect hierarchical spatial patterns (edges -> textures -> objects)
feynman_prompts: How do residual skip connections in ResNet solve the vanishing gradient problem in deep networks?
key_misconceptions: Training deep convolutional networks from scratch on small datasets (< 1,000 images) instead of transfer learning

nodes.title: Natural Language Processing: Embeddings & Transformers
nodes.subtitle: Tokenization (BPE), Word2Vec, BERT embeddings, HuggingFace Transformers, fine-tuning for classification
learning_objectives: Fine-tune transformer language models using HuggingFace Transformers for text classification
Extract dense semantic sentence embeddings using Sentence-Transformers
feynman_prompts: How does bidirectional self-attention in BERT differ from unidirectional causal attention in GPT?
key_misconceptions: Tokenizing text with naive whitespace splitting instead of using the model's dedicated tokenizer

nodes.title: Model Explainability & Interpretability (SHAP & LIME)
nodes.subtitle: Explainable AI (XAI), Shapley values, SHAP summary plots, dependence plots, LIME local explanations
learning_objectives: Explain individual model predictions to business stakeholders using SHAP waterfall plots
Identify global feature interactions and non-linear feature impacts using SHAP dependence analysis
feynman_prompts: What are Shapley values and how do they fairly distribute prediction attribution across all features?
key_misconceptions: Treating high feature importance as evidence of causality rather than statistical correlation

nodes.title: ML Experiment Tracking & Model Registry with MLflow
nodes.subtitle: MLflow tracking, logging parameters, metrics, artifacts, Model Registry, staging to production
learning_objectives: Log experimental runs, hyperparameters, and ROC curves automatically with MLflow
Register and version production-ready model artifacts in the MLflow Model Registry
feynman_prompts: Why is automated experiment tracking critical for team reproducibility compared to manual notes?
key_misconceptions: Saving model weights as unversioned local pickle files on developer laptops

nodes.title: Rigorous Cross-Validation & Preventing Data Leakage
nodes.subtitle: K-Fold cross-validation, StratifiedKFold, TimeSeriesSplit, target encoding leakage, group splits
learning_objectives: Design leak-free temporal validation splits for time-series forecasting datasets
Prevent group-level data leakage across patients or users using GroupKFold
feynman_prompts: Why does using random K-Fold cross-validation on time-series data result in catastrophic look-ahead bias?
key_misconceptions: Performing feature selection or scaling on the entire dataset before splitting into train/test

nodes.title: Handling Class Imbalance & Cost-Sensitive Learning
nodes.subtitle: SMOTE oversampling, RandomUnderSampler, class weights, Focal Loss, threshold tuning
learning_objectives: Balance fraud detection and medical diagnosis models using class weighting and SMOTE
Implement cost-sensitive loss functions that penalize false negatives proportionally
feynman_prompts: Why must synthetic oversampling (SMOTE) be applied strictly to training folds and never to validation folds?
key_misconceptions: Applying SMOTE to validation test sets, artificially inflating test performance metrics

nodes.title: Model Deployment & Serving with FastAPI & Docker
nodes.subtitle: Serializing with ONNX/joblib, building prediction REST APIs with FastAPI, Docker packaging
learning_objectives: Package machine learning models into containerized FastAPI microservices
Validate incoming prediction request payloads and return low-latency inference JSON
feynman_prompts: Why is containerizing ML models with Docker necessary to prevent production dependency drift?
key_misconceptions: Loading multi-gigabyte model weights on every single prediction request instead of at startup

nodes.title: Continuous Model Monitoring: Data & Concept Drift
nodes.subtitle: Covariate shift, concept drift, Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, population stability index (PSI)
learning_objectives: Detect covariate shift between training distributions and live production data with PSI
Trigger automated model retraining alerts when performance metrics degrade over time
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between data drift (input distribution changes) and concept drift (input-to-output relationship changes)?
key_misconceptions: Deploying models to production without continuous monitoring, assuming accuracy remains static

nodes.title: A/B Testing & Online Experimentation for ML
nodes.subtitle: Online vs offline metrics, canary releases for models, interleaving tests, business impact analysis
learning_objectives: Design online A/B experiments comparing challenger ML models against existing baselines
Correlate ML offline evaluation metrics (AUC/RMSE) with live business revenue and conversion rates
feynman_prompts: Why does a model with higher offline validation accuracy sometimes perform worse in online A/B tests?
key_misconceptions: Replacing production models entirely without running canary traffic or shadow deployments

description: Master AI and Data Scientist with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
